question: What makes a deed of transfer valid?
reviewer_notes: SRC001 s2 heading 'Deeds affecting immovable property to be executed before a notary and witnesses' (prevention-of-frauds-consolidated-2024.md:20-35). SRC002 s2 replaces wording 'shall be in force or avail in law unless -' (prevention-of-frauds-amendment-act-30-2022.md:37-39). SRC003 s2 renumbers s2 as subsection (1) (prevention-of-frauds-amendment-act-4-2024.md:37-40).

question: When must a deed be registered? What does registration do?
reviewer_notes: SRC005 s7 heading 'Unregistered instruments void against subsequent registered instruments' (registration-of-documents-consolidated-2024.md:147-168) answers 'what registration does' (priority, not validity). SRC009 NOT_FOUND: this amendment only touches s32 'cancellation ... on a caveat' (registration-of-documents-amendment-act-32-2022.md:34-40; cross-ref at line 767 of the base ordinance), which is about caveats, not registration timing or effect -- citing it for this question would be misleading.

question: What are a notary's duties after making a deed?
reviewer_notes: SRC014 s26 heading 'Duplicates of deeds to be transmitted to [Registrar of Lands]' (notaries-ordinance-english.md:657-663). SRC015 s28: inserts subsection requiring notary to affidavit that duplicates of deeds attested in the previous year were forwarded to the Registrar of Lands (notaries-amendment-act-31-2022.md:189-199). SRC016 explicitly amends 'Section 28 of the Notaries Ordinance' (notaries-amendment-act-6-2024.md:36-38).

question: How is stamp duty calculated? Who pays it?
reviewer_notes: SRC034 s2 'Instruments chargeable with duty' (stamp-duty-act-43-1982.md:21-24); s24 'Duty by whom payable' -- lists grantee/lessee/transferee etc. (stamp-duty-act-43-1982.md:769-794). SRC068 s3 'Charging of stamp duty on instruments and documents' (stamp-duty-special-provisions-act-12-2006-consolidated.md:119-121). SRC069 s6 amends who is liable to pay, incl. notary licence applicants (stamp-duty-special-provisions-amendment-act-10-2008.md:45-60); s8 replaces 'Manner of payment of stamp duty' (same file:62-69).

question: What are the rules on selling land to foreigners?
reviewer_notes: SRC021 s2 heading 'Restriction on transfer of land' -- prohibits transfer to a foreigner/majority-foreign-owned company unless exempted under s3 (land-restrictions-on-alienation-act-38-2014.md:60-74). SRC022 s2 amends s3(1)(b) of the principal Act, substituting the condominium-parcel exemption paragraph (land-restrictions-on-alienation-amendment-act-21-2018.md:35-39).

question: What makes a power of attorney valid?
reviewer_notes: SRC017 s2 (Interpretation) defines 'power of attorney' as executed before two witnesses, or before/attested by a notary public etc. (powers-of-attorney-ordinance-english.md:19-34). SRC018 NOT_FOUND: this amendment only replaces s9 'Fees' payable to the Registrar-General (powers-of-attorney-amendment-act-14-2013.md:28-39) -- no validity requirement found. SRC019 inserts new s3A requiring notarial attestation etc. for POAs used for Prevention-of-Frauds-s2 transactions (powers-of-attorney-amendment-act-28-2022.md:130-168). SRC020 amends the s2 definition's execution wording ('executed before an Ambassador') (powers-of-attorney-amendment-act-3-2024.md:37-39).

question: What makes a last will valid?
reviewer_notes: SRC024 s2 'Disposition of property by a will' -- capacity to make a will (age 18+, testamentary freedom) (wills-consolidated-2024.md:23-27); note original ss3-4 on execution formalities are marked 'Repealed'. SRC025 NOT_FOUND: the 1993 amendment is only visible pre-merged into the consolidated text with no distinct 1993-specific section identifiable. SRC026 s2 replaces the disposition-of-property section (wills-amendment-act-29-2022.md:42-71); s4 repeals original s4 of the principal enactment with no replacement text found in this file (same file:80-83), so the formal-execution requirement could not be located.

question: How does long possession create title?
reviewer_notes: SRC071 s3 heading 'Term of prescription for lands or immovable property' -- ten years' undisturbed and uninterrupted possession entitles defendant to a decree (legislative-enactments-1980-volume-4.md:16547-16561, within Chapter 81 Prescription Ordinance starting at line 16518).

question: How is a condominium unit transferred?
reviewer_notes: SRC012 s9(1): 'No person acquiring an interest in any unit of a registered Condominium Property ... shall be entitled to such interest unless such deed or instrument is registered' (apartment-ownership-law-11-1973.md:79-80); s10 covers redivision/amalgamation of units by registered Plan (same file:82-83). SRC013 NOT_FOUND: this Act only facilitates registration of specific State-owned condominium plans (ss1-5); no unit-transfer mechanism section was found.

question: Which rules apply to Thesawalamai property?
reviewer_notes: SRC045 s2 'Application of Ordinance' -- applies to Tamils governed by Thesawalamai, re: movable/immovable property (matrimonial-rights-and-inheritance-jaffna-consolidated.md:20-27). SRC046 s2 'Restrictions on the right of pre-emption' -- co-owners/heirs have pre-emption right on sale of Thesawalamai property (legislative-enactments-1980-volume-5.md:29060-29079, within Chapter 74 starting line 29045); s4 'Cases in which the right is permitted' -- restricted to undivided-share sales (same file:29056-29065).
